runtimeMapping.selectorMeaning: Global trait establishes highest weight first; native numeric dispatcher is not recovered.
runtimeMapping.s3Pulse: Selected hit_interval once per second, immediate first impact, retained sole victim.
runtimeMapping.s3Duration: Selected hit_duration from impact per link, then source .933 full Skill_End after every link expires, dies or fizzles.
runtimeMapping.s3Bind: Source infinity active bind remains owned by its link, with detachAllBuffsWhenStopped1.
runtimeMapping.squadTalent: Native predeck category1023/filterTag student, no excludeNotInHand or excludeOwner; strongest named ATK percentage composes with ordinary percentage bucket.

limitations: Native C# timing/blackboard loader and frame playback are unrecovered. The selected S3 description/blackboard bridge linkDuration10 and keepAlreadyHitTime1 to rank hit_duration6-8/hit_interval1; native first pulse, per-flight start and full-end ordering remain explicit interpretations.

S3 waitProjectileInvalid1 and minPostDelay .933 are represented by waiting for each actual flight/link followed by the original full .933 Skill_End. Native escapeTime/duration clock ordering is not recovered; no premature SP is accepted in this bounded cast window.

Born unmanaged links retain their original victim across temporary disappearance, skip unavailable hit receipts, and expire on the original bounded timer. They do not retarget. Source link _isSilenceable1 and native dummy attachment/ATK inheritance are unrecovered; current source ATK is used because useCachedAtkOnly0 does not establish a captured ATK. No retained skill-ATK snapshot after withdrawal is claimed.

Native predeck priority, support duplicate resolution and modifier ordering are unrecovered; named strongest talent and an idempotent additive ATK contribution preserve selected faction, promotion and potential semantics.
Source current mass threshold is evaluated per hit with a temporary source/victim/attackId DEF-ignore hook. The exact native dynamic buff cloning/removal order remains unrecovered.
Visual generic arrows and original literal form clips do not reproduce Unity trail/particle/link FX or native animation mixing.
